cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My small trophy shows restraint. I taught you to win without filling the room; put yours beside it and compare.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can read an inscription now. Lovely. Can your huge cup fit in the cupboard without clearing a shelf? Mine can.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And mine doesn't need the announcement. Let's compare modesty. Put both on the mantelpiece, the way I taught you to display things; which one leaves room for anybody else?
